questions.question:
Assertion: Living systems are closed systems
Reason: Energy of living organisms cannot be gained or lost from environment
questions.option_a: Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is correct explanation of Assertion
questions.option_b: Both Assertion and Reason are true but Reason is not the correct explanation of Assertion
questions.option_c: Assertion is true but Reason is false.
questions.option_d: Both Assertion and Reason are false.
questions.explanation:
Living System are Not Closed systems instead They are Open systems that Continuously exchange Both Matter & Energy 

According to The Second Law of Thermodynamics,  No Energy transformation is 100% . Oragnsims Continuously lose Energy to the Environment in the form of Metabolic Heat

questions.question: Identify the correct sequence of taxonomic categories.
questions.option_a: Species -> Genus -> Order -> Class -> Family -> Phylum/Division -> Kingdom
questions.option_b: Species -> Genus -> Family -> Class -> Phylum/Division -> Order -> Kingdom
questions.option_c: Species -> Genus -> Family -> Order -> Class -> Kingdom -> Phylum/Division
questions.option_d: Species -> Genus -> Family -> Order -> Class -> Phylum/Division -> Kingdom
questions.explanation:
A Very Famous Trick For Remembering The Correct Sequence is 

Keep-Kingdom
Pot -Phylum
Clean-Class
Or- Order 
Family -Family 
Gets-Genus 
Sick -Species

questions.question: Triticum and solanum nigrum show maximum similarity at the level of
questions.explanation:
Triticum: Kingdom Plantae → Division Angiosperms → Class Monocotyledonae → Family Poaceae
Solanum nigrum: Kingdom Plantae → Division Angiosperms → Class 
Dicotyledonae → Family Solanaceae
They differ at the class level (monocot vs dicot) but are the same up to the division (Angiosperms).
Correct answer: Division (Angiosperms).
